frozen_method: Exact prior TIED model, sequence-level Discovery supervision, ±2bp common eligible instances, one shift per filter maximizing Discovery information, serialized-PWM rank and frozen calibration. Reuse previous boundary implementation without modification; no forward-only model in this replication.
views: FULL and CAP5 all3 methods; MATCH_SHIFT for RAW/SHIFT and MATCH_OH for SHIFT/OH48 each common min(5,both); zero budget retained as0 F1
primary_endpoint: mut30_random MATCH_SHIFT: TIED_SHIFT minus TIED_RAW reference-assisted full-width localizationF1 ±2bp; mean6 initialization results within data seed first, then mean5 data seeds
initialization_endpoint: Four prespecified new initialization seeds: for each, average paired SHIFT-RAW delta across five data seeds; report individual effects and number positive. The two previously used seeds are listed separately. These six seed means share data and are descriptive, not six independent biological replicates.
pilot_gate: for further independent synthetic follow-up only: primary mean>0, >=4/5 data seeds positive, >=3/4 NEW initialization means positive, CAP5 mean>0, no zero matched budgets, matched family FPR <= RAW, and strong-mode paired mean >= -0.05. Not a claim of significance, functional motif, or superiority over OH48.
test_policy: ALL models, PWMs, Discovery ranks, shifts, membership lists locked before any Development/Test scoring. No tuning to the new Test; changes require new protocol and Test.
statistics: five independent synthetic data seeds; average six algorithm seeds per data seed; two-sided exact sign-flip mean test over32 sign patterns as a descriptive reference conditional on symmetry, minimum p=.0625. Initialization means are paired on the same five data sets and not extra independent samples.
limits: synthetic known12bp contiguous pattern; blank streams repeat across difficulty conditions within a seed; sequence-level CNN supervision; no true motif coordinates/reference during discovery; no new model family, real data fitting, SAE, pretrained-model finetuning, or functional validation
